steps.title: Prepare base DMEM/F12+ media
steps.instruction: Mix DMEM/F12+ (which already contains sodium pyruvate and GlutaMAX) with anti‑anti, N2 supplement, and B27 supplement.

steps.title: Prepare BrainPhys neuron media
steps.instruction: Combine BrainPhys medium with BDNF, GDNF, cAMP, Ascorbic Acid, N2, B27, mouse laminin, sodium pyruvate, GlutaMAX, and anti‑anti.

steps.title: Harvest iPSCs
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL Accutase per well and incubate at 37 °C for 5–10 min (do not exceed 20 min).

steps.title: Neutralize and dilute cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cells in the Accutase, transfer to a 50 mL Falcon tube and add room‑temperature DMEM at a minimum 1:3 (Accutase:DMEM) volumetric ratio. Mix gently.

steps.title: Centrifuge cell suspension
steps.instruction: Spin the tube at 800 g, room temperature, for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Resuspend in StemFlex + THX
steps.instruction: Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 1 mL StemFlex containing ROCK inhibitor Thiazovivin (THX) at 1:1000. Count cells and dilute the suspension to 1 × 10⁶ cells/mL with StemFlex + THX.

steps.title: Add ASCL1, DLX2, rTTA viruses
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL of Ascl1‑PuroR, 50 µL of Dlx2‑HygroR, and 50 µL of rTTA virus per 1 × 10⁶ cells (i.e., 50 µL of each per 10 mL suspension). Mix by inversion and gentle repeated pipetting with a large strip pipette.

steps.title: Plate cells on Matrigel
steps.instruction: Dispense 1.0–1.5 mL of the virus‑treated suspension per well of a 6‑well plate pre‑coated with 1× Matrigel. Incubate overnight (minimum 12 h, maximum 36 h).

steps.title: DIV1 media replacement
steps.instruction: In the virus hood, aspirate the existing media and add induction media containing doxycycline at 1 µg/mL.

steps.title: DIV2 media replacement
steps.instruction: Replace media with induction media containing doxycycline 1 µg/mL, puromycin 2 µg/mL, and hygromycin 250 µg/mL (1:250 dilution of stock).

steps.title: DIV3 optional media change
steps.instruction: If significant cell death is observed, repeat the DIV2 media composition.

steps.title: Start AraC treatment
steps.instruction: On DIV4, add AraC to a final concentration of 4 µM. Continue puromycin 2 µg/mL and hygromycin 250 µg/mL until DIV6.

steps.title: Harvest and replate at DIV6
steps.instruction: Incubate cells with 1 mL Accutase per well at 37 °C for 5 min. Gently resuspend to break clumps, then quench with at least a 1:3 volume of DMEM. Spin 5 min at 800 g, RT. Resuspend pellet in 1 mL neuron media containing doxycycline 1 µg/mL, puromycin 2 µg/mL, hygromycin 250 µg/mL, AraC 4 µM, and THX 1:1000. Count cells, dilute to 1 × 10⁶ cells/mL, mix gently by inversion and pipetting, and plate 2–4 × 10⁶ cells (2–4 mL) per well on either 0.1 % PEI + 2× Matrigel or 4× Matrigel‑coated plates.

steps.title: Adjust AraC at DIV8
steps.instruction: Optionally stop AraC; if flat cells persist, continue AraC at a reduced concentration of 2 µM from DIV8 through DIV14 (maximum).

steps.title: DIV10 media replacement
steps.instruction: Repeat the DIV8 media change (maintain or adjust AraC as decided).

steps.title: DIV14 switch to neuron media
steps.instruction: Replace media with neuron media lacking doxycycline and AraC.

steps.title: Routine media changes
steps.instruction: Perform half‑media changes three times per week or full‑media changes twice per week until the desired harvest time point (commonly DIV35).
